title: Head of Americas Global Banking Business Risk Management

titleByLocale.en: Head of Americas Global Banking Business Risk Management
titleByLocale.it: Responsabile Americas Global Banking Business Risk Management
titleByLocale.de: Leiter Americas Global Banking Business Risk Management
titleByLocale.fr: Responsable Americas Global Banking Business Risk Management

descriptionByLocale.en:
Are you passionate about operational risk and keen to understand how an Investment Bank manages it? Are you self-motivated, driven, and able to lead workstreams to meet deadlines? Do you have the confidence to constructively challenge processes and provide innovative solutions?

We’re looking for someone who can support the Investment Bank in its first-line control and operational risk management activities, specifically to:

• •support delivery of the first line non financial risk and supervisory framework across AMER Global Banking
• •act as a point of contact for risk, supervision and control matters, providing pragmatic, business aligned advice
• •oversee key non financial risk processes, including RCSAs, conflicts of interest and inducements registers, non financial risk events and issues, and remediation tracking
• •review and challenge risk and supervisory MI, escalating material issues and employee conduct incidents as appropriate
• •responsibility to lead local regulatory and audit exams, representing GB BRM
• •build strong relationships with Global Banking senior management and control partners, and present at relevant governance forums
